answer: Near-duplicate detection resists sybil farms: every answer is shingled and MinHash-compared against all others in the epoch, so a fleet mass-producing lightly-reworded templates lands in a tight similarity cluster no independent honest set would form. Genuine work is crystal-distinct; coordinated fakes cluster like echoes in a hollow. Flagging any cluster above a similarity threshold strips the whole group's eligibility, so the cheaper the attacker makes each fake by reusing text, the more detectable the swarm becomes - the haven of templated spam is exactly what the detector keys on.
